transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… student health told me I had to come. They said my weight is too low to clear me for the youth workshops, and I guess the number’s still been going down. I don’t really feel like it’s a big thing… I’ve just been busy and focused.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

I mean… yeah. I don’t like saying that, but even thinking about gaining a pound makes me really anxious. Like if I ate a normal dinner, or something with butter, I’d feel like everyone could tell I’d lost control.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like more than you would normally eat?
I don’t think so. I mean… I don’t really eat like that. I’m not sure what would count as “large,” but… no, not really.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No… I don’t do that. Not really.
Do you exercise a lot?
I don’t know… I mean, I walk sometimes. I wouldn’t really call it a lot.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating?
I’m not really sure… I don’t think so. I don’t usually feel like that when I eat.
Do you ever feel like you're eating much more quickly than usual during a meal?
I don’t think so… I haven’t really noticed eating fast. It’s usually not like that for me.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that's definitely larger than what most people would eat under similar circumstances?
I don’t think so… I mean, I wouldn’t say definitely larger. I don’t really eat like that, I guess.
Do you ever feel like you're eating an unusually large amount of food in one sitting?
No… I don’t think so. Not unusually large, anyway. I don’t really have sittings like that.
Is your fear of gaining weight the main reason you restrict what you eat?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, even the idea of gaining a pound makes me panic. Like if I eat a normal dinner, or something with butter in it, it feels like everyone would be able to tell I lost control or… lost discipline.
Do you think your weight is below a healthy weight for your height?
I mean… people say that. They keep saying it’s dangerous, but it feels kind of exaggerated to me. I don’t really see it that way. I’m just trying to stay sharp for school and my work.
Do you think you look fat even when others say you're too thin?

I… I don’t know if I’d say fat. But when I see pictures of myself, like from the showcase, I don’t even look at the art first. I just check my arms and my waist. If I look small, then I feel like I look… more put-together, I guess. Serious.
Have you ever eaten an amount of food in a short time that you would consider a lot, even if you didn't feel like you lost control?
I’m… not really sure. I don’t usually think of it that way. I mean, maybe other people would say it’s a lot, but I don’t know. I try not to… measure it like that.
Do you regularly have episodes where you eat very little food over a long period of time?

Yeah… I guess so. I kind of plan my day around not eating much. Like coffee before studio, and maybe a few bites of something if people are around. I usually avoid bread or anything oily… it just feels like it would undo the control.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a lot of food in a short amount of time?
I don’t think so… not like, a lot. I mean, sometimes I might eat more than I planned, but I wouldn’t really call it an episode.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel like you are eating much more than you normally would?
Sometimes it feels like more than I meant to eat… but I don’t know if it’s much more than normal. I try not to think about it that way.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel like you've eaten much more than you normally would and then try to compensate for it?
I’m not really sure. I mean… if I feel like I ate more than I wanted, I might try to be more careful after, but I don’t know if I’d call it compensating.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a significantly large amount of food in a short period of time?
I don’t think so. Not like a huge amount all at once… I mean, maybe it feels that way sometimes, but I wouldn’t really say it’s significantly large.
Do you regularly have episodes where you eat a lot of food in a short amount of time, followed by restricting your food intake?
I don’t think that’s really a regular thing for me. If I feel like I ate too much, I might pull back afterward, but… I don’t know. It’s not like I’m having big episodes or anything.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel like you've eaten much more than you normally would?
I mean… sometimes it feels like that, but I’m not sure if it actually is much more than normal. It’s hard for me to tell.
